description: This file defines a ToastService class for displaying notifications (toasts) with different levels (Info, Success, Warning, Error) in a Blazor web application. It manages showing and hiding toast messages with a countdown timer.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: A service class that handles displaying toast notifications in the application, managing their lifecycle and timing.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast message with a specified message and level, then starts a countdown to hide it.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Initializes and starts the countdown timer to auto-hide the toast notification.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Creates and sets up the Timer instance if it does not exist, configures its interval and event handler.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler called when the timer elapses; triggers hiding the toast notification.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by disposing of the timer when the service is disposed.
